spans.s: पशव्य a. (f. व्या) 1. Fit or suitable for cattle, Yaj.i.321; 2. relating to cattle; 3. possessed of cattle; 4. brutish.
पशव्य a. (f. व्या) 1. Fit or suitable for cattle, Yaj.i.321; 2. relating to cattle; 3. possessed of cattle; 4. brutish.

पशु m. 1. Cattle (singly and collectively), M.ix.327; 2. an animal in general; 3. a brute, a beast; (sometimes contemptuously applied to a man, e.g. पुरुषपशोश्च पशोश्चको विशेषः); 4. name of a subordinate deity, one of Śiva’s followers.
पशु-अवदान n. a sacrifice of animals.
पशु-क्रिया f. 1. the act of animal-sacrifice; 2. copulation.
पशु-गायत्री f. a mantra whispered into the car of an animal about to be sacrificed. (It is this- पशुपाशाय विद्महे विश्वकर्मणे धीमहि । तत्रो जीवः प्रचोदयात्.)
पशु-घात m. slaughter of animals for sacrifice, सदयहृदयदर्शितपशुघातम् Git.G.i.
पशु-चर्या f. copulation.
पशु-धर्म m. 1. treatment of cattle; 2. promiscuous cohabitation, M.ix.66; 3. the marrying of widows.
पशु-नाथ m. an epithet of Śiva.
पशु-प m. a herdsman.
पशु-पति m. 1. a herdsman; 2. an epithet of Śiva, Megh.i.36, 56, K.S.vi.95, Bh.V.iv.38; 3. name of a philosopher who propounded the pāśupata system of philosophy.
पाशुपत (I) a. (f. ती) Relating or sacred to Paśupati.
पशु-पाल, -पालक m. a herdsman.
पशु-पाल, -पालक m. a herdsman.
पशु-पालन n. rearing cattle.
पशु-पाशक m. a particular mode of sexual enjoyment.
पशु-प्रेरण n. the driving of cattle.
पशु-मारम् ind. according to the manner of slaughtering cattle, e.g. पशुमारं मारितः.
पशु-यज्ञ, -याग m. an animal-sacrifice.
पशु-यज्ञ, -याग m. an animal-sacrifice.
पशु-रज्जु f. a cord for tethering cattle.
पशु-राज m. a lion.

पश्चात् ind. (used either absolutely or with a gen. or abl.) 1. From behind, behind, पश्चादुच्चैर्भवति हरिणः स्वांगमायच्छमानः Sak.iv.; 2. after, afterwards, subsequently, पश्चादद्रिग्रहणगुरुभिर्गर्जितैर्नर्तयेथाः Megh.i.44, 30, R.xii.7, 17, 39; 3. at last, lastly; 4. from the west, westward.
पश्चार्ध m. 1. the hinder part of the body, पश्चार्धेन प्रविष्टः शरपतनभयाद्भूयता पूर्वकायम् Sak.i.; 2. the latter half.
पश्चात्-कृत a. put into the shade, defeated.
पश्चात्-ताप m. repentance, remorse.

पश्चिम a. (f. मा) 1. Being behind, hindmost; 2. last, पश्चिमाद्यामिनीयामात्प्रसादमिव चेतना R.xvii.1, स्मरंतः पश्चिमामाज्ञां भर्तुः संग्रामयायिनः xvii.8, xix.1, M.vii.145; 3. westerly, western.(The inst. sing. पश्चिमेन is used as an indeclinable in the sense of- (1) behind, after, (with an acc.); (2) in the west.)

पश्चिम a. (f. मा) 1. Being behind, hindmost; 2. last, पश्चिमाद्यामिनीयामात्प्रसादमिव चेतना R.xvii.1, स्मरंतः पश्चिमामाज्ञां भर्तुः संग्रामयायिनः xvii.8, xix.1, M.vii.145; 3. westerly, western.(The inst. sing. पश्चिमेन is used as an indeclinable in the sense of- (1) behind, after, (with an acc.); (2) in the west.)
पश्चिमा f. The west.
पश्चिम-अर्ध m. the latter half, the hinder part.
पश्चिम-रात्र m. the latter part of the night, e.g. उपारताः पश्चिमरात्रगोचरात् Kir.iv.10. (The reading of Mall. however, is पश्चिमरात्रि.)
पश्चिमा-उत्तरा f. the north-west.
पश्यत् a. (f. न्ती) Seeing, beholding, looking, observing &c.
पश्यत् a. (f. न्ती) Seeing, beholding, looking, observing &c.
पश्यंती f. 1. A harlot, a courtezan; 2. a particular sound.
पश्यतोहर m. a robber, a highway-man.
पस्त्य n. A house, a habitation.
पस्पश n. Name of the first āhnika of the first chapter of Patanjali’s Mahābhāshya, शब्दविद्येव नो भाति राजनीतिपस्पशा Sis.ii.112; (hence) an introductory chapter generally.

पाश m. 1. A snare, a trap, a cord, a fetter, पादाकृष्टव्रततिवलयासंगजातपाशः Sak.i., Bt.ix.59; 2. a snare for catching birds; 3. a noose employed as a weapon; 4. a die (Mall. on R.vi.18); 5. kind of weapon.(At the end of a compound, पाश sometimes expresses ‘contempt or depreciation,’ e.g. भिषक्‌पाश ‘a bad physician,’ and sometimes ‘beauty or admiration,’ e.g. कर्णपाश ‘a beautiful ear.’ When affixed to words meaning ‘hair,’ it has the sense of ‘mass, quantity,’ Sis.viii.62. See under हस्त.)
पाश-अंत m. the back of a garment.
पाश-क्रीडा f. gambling, playing with dice.
पाश-धर, -पाणि m. an epithet of Varuṇa.
पाश-धर, -पाणि m. an epithet of Varuṇa.
पाश-बद्ध a. entraped, caught in a net.
पाश-बंध n. a noose, a lantern.
पाश-बंधक m. a bird-catcher.
पाश-बंधन n. a snare.
पाश-भृत् m. an epithet of Varuṇa, R.ii.9.
पाश-रज्जु f. a fetter, a rope.
पाश-हस्त m. an epithet of Varuṇa.
पाशक m. A die, dice.
पाषक m. An ornament for the feet.
पाशक-पीठ n. a gambling table.
पाशन n. 1. A noose, a snare; 2. fettering, entrapping.
पाशव (I) a. (f. वी) Relating to animals.
पाशव (II) n. A flock, a herd.
पाशव (I) a. (f. वी) Relating to animals.
पाशव-पालन n. grass.
पाशित a. (f. ता) Bound, fettered.
पाशित a. (f. ता) Bound, fettered.
पाशिन् m. 1. An epithet of Varuṇa; 2. of Yama; 3. a deer-catcher, a fowler.
पाशुपत (I) a. (f. ती) Relating or sacred to Paśupati.
पाशुपत (II) m. A follower of the doctrines of Paśupati, an old philosopher.
पाशुपत (III) n. The teaching of Paśupati.
पाशुपत-अस्त्र n. name of a missile presided over by Paśupati q.v.
पाशुपाल्य n. The breeding and rearing of cattle.
पाश्चात्य (I) a. (f. त्या) 1. Hinder; 2. western; 3. posterior, later, subsequent.
पाश्चात्य (II) n. The hinder part.
पाश्चात्य (I) a. (f. त्या) 1. Hinder; 2. western; 3. posterior, later, subsequent.
पाश्या f. 1. a net; 2. a number of ropes.
पाषंड m. The same as पाखंड q.v., M.v.90.
पाषंडक m. A heretic, Yaj.ii.130 (the reading of some editions being पाखंडिन्).
पाषंडक m. A heretic, Yaj.ii.130 (the reading of some editions being पाखंडिन्).
पाषाण m. A stone.
पाषाण-दारक, -दारण m. a stone-cutter’s chisel.
पाषाण-दारक, -दारण m. a stone-cutter’s chisel.
पाषाण-संधि m. a cave in a rock.
पाषाण-हृदय a. stone-hearted, cruel.
पाषाणी f. A small stone used as a weight.
